title: KitBag machine configuration (config.toml)
description: Schema version 1 of the machine-local tool configuration, normally ~/.config/kitbag/config.toml. It describes this machine only: which repository to follow, how to reach Git, how often to poll, the materialization default and UI preferences. Nothing in it is shared through the repository. See docs/manifest.md.

schema.description: Configuration schema version. A tool that knows version N reads N and N-1 and rejects everything else.

host.description: Name used to select hosts.<name> in the manifest and the {host} template. Default: the machine's short host name.

url.description: Clone URL of the configuration repository (https://, ssh:// or git@host:path). Credentials never belong here.

branch.description: Branch to follow. Default: the remote's default branch.

path.description: Working copy location. Default: the platform data directory, for example ~/.local/share/kitbag/repos/<name>.

backend.description: auto prefers system Git 2.30+ and falls back to embedded go-git only when git is absent; system and embedded force one backend and fail when it is unavailable.

identity.description: Fallback unsigned commit identity for embedded Git when Git configuration supplies none. Both name and email are required when this table is present.

poll_interval.description: How often the daemon fetches, as a duration such as 60s, 15m or 1h30m. Default: 60s.

mode.description: Machine default materialization mode where the manifest leaves it unset. Default: link on macOS and Linux, copy on Windows.

notifications.description: Show a system notification after changes are applied. Default: true.

legacy_roots.description: Explicit old configuration clone and shared-skill roots, relative to HOME. Empty or absent means strict foreign-link protection. No locations are guessed.

items.description: A known legacy source root, relative to HOME.
